name: kickoff depth
description: #397 (balance/plans/kickoff-depth.md): the deeper default kick-off (the receivers' 15–8 m line by the kicker's Skill, 35–42 m from halfway) against the old one (their 24 m line, about 26 m): points, tries, completion and possession inside the §7 bands, for even sides, a rating gap and the attacking and defence styles? Baseline is the default (deeper, kickoff.deepDefault 1); the variant is the old kick-off. No coach calls.
